tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the GameShipKit catalogue of browser tools for game developers (sprites, AI art cleanup, audio, store assets, economy, dialogue, rigging and more). Returns names, short descriptions and links. Use it to point the user to the right tool for a task.

tools.name: palette
tools.description: Game colour palettes. action "list" shows the built-in palettes, "get" returns one (PICO-8, Sweetie 16, Endesga 32, Game Boy, NES style), "convert" turns pasted hex codes or a GIMP .gpl file into hex, gpl or json.

tools.name: xp_curve
tools.description: Make a level-up XP table for an RPG or idle game. Returns XP needed per level and in total, as a table or as ready-to-paste GDScript, C# or JSON. Needs GameShipKit Pro.

tools.name: store_link
tools.description: Build tracked store links for a game launch: Google Play (UTM inside the referrer parameter), App Store (campaign token ct and provider token pt), Steam or any web page. One link per traffic source. Needs GameShipKit Pro.

tools.name: app_ads_txt
tools.description: Write and check an app-ads.txt file for mobile ad networks (AdMob, Meta Audience Network, Unity Ads, AppLovin or custom lines). Returns the file text and warnings about common mistakes. Needs GameShipKit Pro.
